messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Jenkins pull request admin privileges
parts:
When we first went to a gitflow-like process, I added Bob and myself as admins. It was only meant to be a limited group until we kind of got the process down and understood the bottleneck and how it affected our build server.

I just added the whole stan-dev member list to the white list, so any pull request created by us will kick off a build. Any additional commits on existing pull requests will also create more test jobs. I added the organization, so hopefully any future changes will reflect on that list.

I added, by hand, all the existing members to the admin list on Jenkins. The commands to control Jenkins:
- "Jenkins, ok to test" -- accept to testing phase for a pull request by a member not on the white list. This should kick off a build automatically.
- "Jenkins, test this please" or "Jenkins, retest this please" -- will put a build on the testing queue.


Marcus, can you try the test phrase on the last pull request again? I didn't get around to updating Jenkins until just now.

Just a reminder, this is where Jenkins is located on the web:
http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/


Daniel
